build_OLN_RoI_head: build an OLN RoI head that extracts region features and predicts bbox regression and localization quality
run_bbox_forward: run the box head forward pass to extract RoI features and compute cls_score, bbox_pred, and bbox_score
run_bbox_forward_train: run the box head forward training pass to compute loss using sampling results and ground truth bboxes
test_simple_test_bboxes: test detection bboxes without augmentation by splitting proposals per image and applying post-processing
review_OlnRoIHead_class: review the OlnRoIHead class that extends StandardRoIHead for open-world object proposal localization
